skill.summary: Optimize Docker Compose configurations for development and production — audit services, networking, volumes, health checks, and resource management.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of docker-compose-optimizer

- Analyze Docker Compose files for best practices in security, performance, and production readiness.
- Audit service configurations, volumes, networking, health checks, and resource/resource management.
- Distinguish between development and production setups, suggesting overrides and profiles.
- Provide actionable output listing issues, improvements, and validated good practices.
- Offer guidance on secrets management, image tagging, resource limits, and proper network/volume setups.
